content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Makes cellulose and polymer ingredients for personal care and pharma, not industrial process fluids or metalworking chemicals."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Broad specialty materials, fibers and plastics recycling for many industries; no metalworking fluids, oils or greases."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Welding and cutting equipment and consumables; shares metal-fabrication customers but not chemical fluids or coatings."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Pumps, valves and seals for fluid handling; plant customers overlap but products and service model differ."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Pumps, valves, brake friction parts and connectors; equipment and components, not chemical process fluids."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Papermaking machinery and wood processing equipment; no chemical formulation or consumable fluids for metalworking."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Distributes metalworking tools and MRO supplies rather than formulating and selling its own chemical fluids."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Mainly paints and architectural coatings with retail and contractor channels; only industrial coatings partly overlap."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Locks, hardware and metal castings made in its own plants; no chemicals, fluids or technical chemical services."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Coding and marking printers and water instruments; equipment-led business rather than chemical fluids for manufacturers."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Commercial plumbing fixtures and water filtration for buildings; serves different customers with different products."}]}
